text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation as I enter this modern, well-lit space that seems designed for innovation and learning. The tilted perspective makes me aware of my presence, almost as if I'm intruding upon a carefully structured environment dedicated to research and development. The bold 'R+D' on the wall reminds me that in this place, ideas are meant to be questioned and boundaries pushed. I am both observer and participant in this unfolding journey of discovery, surrounded by the hum of knowledge and creative energy.
